# Interview Reader

> Free interview questions with detailed answers for Java, React, Node.js, Go, SQL, System Design, Kafka, Microservices, Design Patterns, Angular and Rails, plus 2,500+ coding problems you can run online in 11 languages, company interview roadmaps and DSA problem sheets.

Every question has its own page at a readable URL, for example `https://interviewreader.cloud/what-is-the-bulkhead-pattern`. Some topics are members-only; a free sample of each topic is open to everyone. Pages are served to AI and search assistants as plain HTML (no JavaScript needed), showing the same content a signed-out visitor can read. Answers marked as members-only are not shown to crawlers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://interviewreader.cloud/): browse interview questions by technology.
- [Coding problems](https://interviewreader.cloud/problems): 2,500+ problems with test cases, filterable by company, topic and difficulty.
- [Practice coding online](https://interviewreader.cloud/practice): online editor that runs Java, Python, C++, Go, JavaScript and more.
- [Company roadmaps](https://interviewreader.cloud/roadmaps): round-by-round interview roadmaps for top tech companies.
- [Question of the day](https://interviewreader.cloud/question-of-the-day): a new interview question every day, with an answer.
- [Mock interviews and solo system design practice](https://interviewreader.cloud/interview): practise a live mock interview, or a scored solo design round.
- [Interview experiences and discussions](https://interviewreader.cloud/discuss): real interview experiences and compensation reports.
- [Free resume builder](https://interviewreader.cloud/resume): ATS-friendly LaTeX resume templates, download as PDF.
- [Leaderboard](https://interviewreader.cloud/leaderboard): weekly learning leagues.
- [Pricing](https://interviewreader.cloud/pricing) and [Free vs Premium](https://interviewreader.cloud/premium): what is free and what Premium adds.

## Role-wise tracks

- [All role tracks](https://interviewreader.cloud/tracks): ordered study paths by role.
- [Java Backend](https://interviewreader.cloud/tracks/java-backend), [Frontend](https://interviewreader.cloud/tracks/frontend), [Full Stack](https://interviewreader.cloud/tracks/full-stack), [Go Backend](https://interviewreader.cloud/tracks/go-backend), [Ruby on Rails](https://interviewreader.cloud/tracks/rails-backend).

## Guides by topic

- [Java interview questions](https://interviewreader.cloud/java-interview-questions): core Java, collections, concurrency, JVM and Spring.
- [Spring Boot interview questions](https://interviewreader.cloud/spring-boot-interview-questions): auto-configuration, transactions, JPA, security.
- [LLD interview questions](https://interviewreader.cloud/lld-interview-questions): low-level design and design patterns.
- [Kafka interview questions](https://interviewreader.cloud/kafka-interview-questions): partitions, consumer groups, delivery guarantees.
- [SDE-2 interview preparation](https://interviewreader.cloud/sde-2-preparation): DSA, system design, LLD and behavioral plan.
- [Amazon SDE-2 interview](https://interviewreader.cloud/companies/amazon/sde-2): rounds, Amazon-tagged problems and preparation.
- [Sliding window problems](https://interviewreader.cloud/dsa/sliding-window): the pattern and problems to practise.

## Topics (questions with answers)

- Java, React, Node.js, Go (Golang), SQL, Kafka, Microservices, Design Patterns (low-level design), System Design (high-level design), Angular, Ruby on Rails, Behavioral.
- Readable without an account: Microservices, and the first few Design Patterns questions. A free account unlocks a sample of every other topic (for example the first few System Design questions and roughly the first third of Java, Node.js, Go, Kafka, React and Rails); the rest is for Premium members.

- [Striver A2Z DSA sheet](https://interviewreader.cloud/sheets/striver-a2z): the A2Z DSA course problems, runnable online.
